Open models from Hugging Face's inference providers through one router: chat, embeddings, images, speech.

## API key

1. Open [huggingface.co](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens/new?ownUserPermissions=inference.serverless.write&tokenType=fineGrained) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** A fine-grained access token from Hugging Face settings with the Inference Providers permission.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add huggingface
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  huggingface: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Hugging Face Inference's [API](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show huggingface` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Pay as you go at each provider's own rate with no markup; PRO accounts get $2 of compute credits a month.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Hugging%20Face%20Inference).
